sources.authors: Bryan Hirschorn, Mark E. Orazem, Bernard Tribollet, Vincent Vivier, Isabelle Frateur, Marco Musiani
sources.title: Determination of effective capacitance and film thickness from constant-phase-element parameters

records.claim_ko: 논문은 CPE 가 있는 패러데이 반응을 Z = R_e + R_t/(1 + (jω)^α Q R_t) 로 쓰며 (CPE 임피던스 1/((jω)^α Q)), α = 1 이면 Q 가 계면 커패시턴스(µF/cm²)다.
records.claim: The paper writes a Faradaic reaction with CPE dispersion as Z = R_e + R_t/(1 + (jω)^α Q R_t), i.e. a CPE impedance of 1/((jω)^α Q), and for α = 1 the parameter Q is the interfacial capacitance (µF/cm²).
records.conditions: Faradaic reaction without diffusion; R_e = Ohmic resistance, R_t = charge-transfer resistance; alpha and Q independent of frequency. Q and R are per unit area in the paper.

records.claim_ko: 블로킹 전극의 임피던스는 옴 저항과 CPE 의 직렬, Z = R_e + 1/((jω)^α Q) 이며, α = 1 이면 Q 가 계면의 미분 용량이다.
records.claim: For a blocking electrode the impedance is the Ohmic resistance in series with a CPE, Z = R_e + 1/((jω)^α Q), where Q is the differential capacity of the interface when α = 1.
records.conditions: Blocking (non-Faradaic) interface; the R_t -> infinity form of Eq. (1).

records.claim_ko: α < 1 이면 CPE 의 Q 는 커패시턴스가 아니며 변환식이 필요하다.
records.claim: When α < 1 the CPE parameter Q does not represent a capacitance, so a conversion formula is required.
records.conditions: Any CPE with alpha < 1. At alpha = 1, Q is the capacitance.

records.claim_ko: 원판 전극 시뮬레이션에서 Q_eff 를 그대로 계면 커패시턴스로 쓰면 K = 100 에서 약 500% 오차가 났다 (α 가 1 에 가까운 작은 J 에서도).
records.claim: In disk-electrode simulations with geometry-induced dispersion, taking the CPE coefficient Q_eff as the interfacial capacitance gave errors of about 500% at K = 100, even for small J, where α is close to 1.

values.source: Fig. 3, taken from Huang et al. [13]

records.conditions: Disk electrode; geometry-induced (surface) pseudo-CPE at high frequency.

records.claim_ko: CPE 거동은 전극 표면을 따라 퍼진 시정수 분포(surface) 에서도, 표면에 수직인 막 두께 방향 분포(normal) 에서도 나올 수 있다.
records.claim: CPE behaviour can come from a distribution of time constants along the electrode surface (surface distribution) or from one normal to the surface, e.g. through a film (normal distribution).
records.conditions: Either type yields a CPE for an appropriate distribution function.

records.claim_ko: 표면 분포에서는 국소 어드미턴스가 더해지고, 옴 저항이 없으면 1/R_eff = Σ1/R_i, C_eff = ΣC_i 인 이상적 RC 하나로 모인다 — 표면 분포가 CPE 를 만들려면 옴 저항이 필요하다.
records.claim: In a surface distribution the local admittances add; without an Ohmic resistance they collapse to a single ideal RC with 1/R_eff = Σ1/R_i and C_eff = ΣC_i, so CPE behaviour from a surface distribution needs an Ohmic resistance.
records.math: no R_e: 1/R_eff = sum_i 1/R_i ; C_eff = sum_i C_i (Eqs. 3-4). With R_e: Y = sum_i (R_e,i + R_i/(1 + j*omega*R_i*C_i))^-1 (Eq. 5)
records.conditions: Surface (lateral) distribution of local R_i, C_i; Fig. 1(a) with and 1(b) without Ohmic resistance.

records.claim_ko: 층 두께 방향 분포에서는 국소 임피던스가 더해지고 (Voigt 직렬), CPE 가 나타나는 데 옴 저항이 필요 없으며, R_e 는 분산에 기여하지 않으므로 Z − R_e = R_f/(1 + (jω)^α Q R_f) (R_f = ΣR_i) 로 다룬다.
records.claim: In a normal distribution through a layer the local impedances add (a Voigt series, Z = R_e + Σ R_i/(1 + jωR_iC_i)), the CPE needs no Ohmic resistance, and since R_e does not contribute to the dispersion the analysis uses Z − R_e = R_f/(1 + (jω)^α Q R_f) with R_f = ΣR_i.
records.math: Z = R_e + sum_i R_i/(1 + j*omega*R_i*C_i) (Eq. 13); Z - R_e = R_f/(1 + (j*omega)^alpha*Q*R_f) (Eq. 14); R_f = sum_i R_i (Eq. 15)
records.conditions: Normal (through-thickness) distribution; needs both resistive and capacitive elements.

records.claim_ko: 패러데이 반응이 있는 표면 분포에서 C_eff = Q^(1/α)·(R_eR_t/(R_e+R_t))^((1−α)/α) (= Q^(1/α)(1/R_e+1/R_t)^((α−1)/α)) 이며, Brug 의 식 (20) 을 이 논문의 CPE 정의로 쓴 것이다.
records.claim: For a surface distribution with a Faradaic reaction, C_eff = Q^(1/α) (R_e R_t/(R_e + R_t))^((1−α)/α), equivalently Q^(1/α) (1/R_e + 1/R_t)^((α−1)/α), which is Brug's Eq. (20) written with this paper's CPE definition.
records.math: C_eff = Q^(1/alpha) * (R_e*R_t/(R_e+R_t))^((1-alpha)/alpha) (Eq. 11); tau0 = (R_e*R_t/(R_e+R_t)) * C_eff (Eq. 8); tau0^alpha = Q*R_e*R_t/(R_e+R_t) (Eq. 9)
records.conditions: Surface time-constant distribution with circuit R_e + (R_t ∥ CPE) (Eq. 1). tau0 is defined from the admittance form (Eqs. 6-7), not from the apex of the Nyquist arc.

records.claim_ko: R_t → ∞ (블로킹 전극) 극한에서 표면 분포 식은 C_eff = Q^(1/α)·R_e^((1−α)/α) (R_e = 옴 저항) 가 되며, Brug 의 블로킹 전극 식 (5) 와 같다.
records.claim: In the limit R_t → ∞ (blocking electrode) the surface-distribution formula becomes C_eff = Q^(1/α) R_e^((1−α)/α), with R_e the Ohmic resistance, equivalent to Brug's Eq. (5) for a blocking electrode.
records.conditions: Blocking electrode Z = R_e + 1/((jω)^α Q) (Eq. 2) with a surface distribution. The paper says it 'applies strictly for a blocking electrode' (p. 6221).
records.quote: which is equivalent to Eq. (5) presented by Brug et al. [1] for a blocking electrode.

records.claim_ko: 두께 방향(normal) 분포에서 C_eff = Q^(1/α)·R_f^((1−α)/α) (R_f = 막 저항, τ0^α = (R_f C_eff)^α = Q R_f) 이며, Hsu–Mansfeld 가 유도 없이 ω_max 로 쓴 식 (3) 과 같다.
records.claim: For a normal distribution C_eff = Q^(1/α) R_f^((1−α)/α), with R_f the film resistance and τ0^α = (R_f C_eff)^α = Q R_f. The paper says this equals Hsu and Mansfeld's Eq. (3), which they gave without derivation in terms of ω_max.
records.conditions: Normal time-constant distribution; R_f = sum of R_i is the resistance in parallel with the CPE once R_e is removed (Eq. 14).
records.quote: Eq. (18) is equivalent to Eq. (3) presented without derivation by Hsu and Mansfeld [11] in terms of ωmax.

records.claim_ko: 식 (11)·(12)·(18) 은 모두 C_eff = Q^(1/α)·R*^((1−α)/α) 꼴이고 R* 만 다르다: 표면·패러데이면 R_e∥R_t, 표면·블로킹이면 R_e, 두께 방향(normal)이면 R_f.
records.claim: Eqs. (11), (12) and (18) all have the form C_eff = Q^(1/α) R*^((1−α)/α) and differ only in R*: R_e∥R_t for a Faradaic surface distribution, R_e for a blocking surface distribution, and R_f for a normal distribution.
records.math: C_eff = Q^(1/alpha) * Rstar^((1-alpha)/alpha); Rstar = R_e*R_t/(R_e+R_t) (Eq. 11) | R_e (Eq. 12) | R_f (Eq. 18)
records.conditions: R* is chosen by the distribution type, not by how the circuit is drawn.

records.claim_ko: α 와 Q 는 허수부에서 α = |d log|Z_j|/d log f|, Q_eff = sin(απ/2)·(−1/(Z_j ω^α)) 로 읽을 수 있고 회귀와 같은 값을 준다. 특성 주파수보다 한 decade 위 구간을 썼으며, α 는 기울기를 잰 주파수에 따라 달랐다.
records.claim: α and Q can be read from the imaginary impedance as α = |d log|Z_j| / d log f| and Q_eff = sin(απ/2)·(−1/(Z_j ω^α)), giving the same values as regression. The analysis used frequencies a decade above the characteristic frequency, and α depended on where the slope was taken.
records.math: alpha = |d log|Z_j| / d log f| (Eq. 19); Q_eff = sin(alpha*pi/2) * (-1/(Z_j * omega^alpha)) (Eq. 20)

values.frequency_window: frequencies one decade above the characteristic frequency (following Huang et al. [13])

records.conditions: High-frequency CPE region of an arc. By our algebra it is exact at every frequency for a series R_e + CPE, where Z_j = −sin(απ/2)/(Q ω^α).

records.claim_ko: 원판 전극의 기하 유래(표면) 분산은 무차원 주파수 K = ωC0r0/κ 와 J = (4/π)R_e/R_t 로 나타낸다. J 가 크면 옴 저항이, 작으면 전하전달 저항이 지배한다.
records.claim: Geometry-induced (surface) dispersion on a disk electrode is described by the dimensionless frequency K = ωC0r0/κ and by J = (4/π)R_e/R_t. Large J means the Ohmic resistance dominates; small J means charge transfer dominates.
records.where: Section 3.1, definition of K (Eq. (24) for J on p. 6221)
records.math: K = omega*C0*r0/kappa; J = (4/pi)*R_e/R_t (Eq. 24); linear kinetics: J = (alpha_a + alpha_c)*F*i0*r0/(R*T*kappa) (Eq. 21)
records.conditions: Disk electrode embedded in an insulating plane (simulations of Huang et al.); r0 = disk radius, κ = electrolyte conductivity, C0 = interfacial capacitance.

records.claim_ko: 패러데이 원판 전극 시뮬레이션에서 블로킹 식 (12) 는 α 를 K < 5 에서 구하면 맞고 K > 5 에서는 틀렸으며, 오차는 K 와 J 모두에 달렸다.
records.claim: On simulated Faradaic disk electrodes, the blocking-electrode formula Eq. (12) gave the correct capacitance when α was evaluated at K < 5 but failed for K > 5, with an error that depends on both K and J.

values.approx_note: read from Fig. 4(a) for J = 10 at K of about 80-100; not printed as a number

records.conditions: Surface (geometry-induced) distribution with a Faradaic reaction; alpha and Q_eff taken as functions of frequency (pseudo-CPE).

records.claim_ko: R_e 와 R_t 를 모두 보정한 식 (11) 은 J 의존성을 크게 줄여 오차를 20% 미만으로 지켰고, 분산이 클 때 시험한 식 가운데 가장 좋았다.
records.claim: Correcting for both R_e and R_t (Eq. 11) greatly reduced the dependence on J and kept the capacitance error below 20%, making Eq. (11) the best of the tested relations when frequency dispersion is significant.
records.conditions: Simulated disk electrode with a Faradaic reaction (surface distribution).

records.claim_ko: 두께 방향 식 (18) 을 표면 분포 시뮬레이션에 쓰면 Q 를 그대로 쓰는 것보다는 낫지만 J·K 에 따라 −70% ~ +100% 틀렸다. 논문은 표면 분포 해석에 부적절하다고 본다.
records.claim: Tested on the simulated surface distribution, the normal-distribution formula Eq. (18) improved on using Q directly but erred by −70% to +100% depending on J and K. The paper calls it not appropriate for surface time-constant distributions.
records.conditions: Disk-electrode simulations of Huang et al. [13], Fig. 5.
records.quote: Eq. (18), developed for a normal time-constant distribution, is not appropriate for interpretation of results affected by a surface time-constant distribution.

records.claim_ko: Nb 전극의 고주파 CPE (300 Hz 이상에서 기울기 −0.90) 는 산화막 탓으로 봤다. 기하 유래 표면 분산은 K = 1 (약 65 kHz) 근처에서야 나타나는데, 측정 최고 주파수가 63.1 kHz 였기 때문이다.
records.claim: For the Nb electrode, the high-frequency CPE (slope −0.90 above 300 Hz) was attributed to the oxide film, because geometry-induced surface dispersion would only appear near K = 1, about 65 kHz, above the highest measured frequency of 63.1 kHz.
records.conditions: Nb rotating disk electrode, 0.25 cm², 0.1 M NH4F at pH 2, 6 V(SCE).

records.claim_ko: 유전율이 위치에 무관한 normal 분포에서는 d_eff = εε0/C_eff (ε0 = 8.8542×10⁻¹⁴ F/cm, C_eff 는 단위면적당) 로 막 두께를 얻는다.
records.claim: For normal distributions with a position-independent dielectric constant, the film thickness follows from d_eff = εε0/C_eff, with ε0 = 8.8542×10^-14 F/cm and C_eff per unit area.
records.math: C_eff = eps * eps0 / d_eff (Eq. 25); eps0 = 8.8542e-14 F/cm
records.conditions: Normal time-constant distribution; uniform ε; C_eff from Eq. (18). Exact only in the infinite-frequency limit (HIRSCHORN2010.deff-between-lambda-and-delta).

records.claim_ko: Nb2O5 막에서 식 (18) (그래프로 구한 α·Q, 루프 지름 R_f) 은 2·6·10 V(SCE) 에서 C_eff = 4.6·2.0·1.3 µF/cm², ε = 42 로 d_eff = 8·18·29 nm 를 주었다.
records.claim: For Nb2O5 films, Eq. (18) with graphical α and Q and R_f taken as the loop diameter gave C_eff = 4.6, 2.0 and 1.3 µF/cm², and with ε = 42 gave d_eff = 8, 18 and 29 nm at 2, 6 and 10 V(SCE).

recomputed_by_us_from_printed_inputs.note: our effective_capacitance(R_f*1e3, Q, alpha) gives the same C_eff; d_eff at 10 V recomputes to 28.2 nm against 29 printed, so use about 5% tolerance

records.conditions: Normal distribution assumed (oxide film). R_f from the diameter of the high-frequency loop; alpha from the slope above 300 Hz (at 6 V).

records.claim: The Eq. (18) + Eq. (25) thicknesses (8, 18, 29 nm) agreed very well with independent literature values (11/10/7, 22/19/15 and 33/28/24 nm), especially with non-electrochemical measurements.
records.conditions: Ref. [51]: ellipsometry; Ref. [52]: TEM and impedance; Ref. [50]: review (method not stated).

records.claim_ko: Nb 막에 표면 식 (식 (11) 에서 R_t 대신 R_f; R_f ≫ R_e 라 식 (12) 와 같음) 을 쓰면 C_eff = 3.2·0.9·0.5 µF/cm², d_eff = 12·41·74 nm 로 8·18·29 nm 보다 두껍게 나왔고, 전위가 높을수록 더 벌어졌다.
records.claim: Using the surface formula for the Nb film (Eq. 11 with R_t replaced by R_f, the same as Eq. 12 because R_f ≫ R_e) gave C_eff = 3.2, 0.9 and 0.5 µF/cm² and d_eff = 12, 41 and 74 nm, against 8, 18 and 29 nm, and the overestimate grew with potential.

values.R_e: not printed, so these rows cannot be used as input-to-output anchors for Eq. (12)

records.conditions: A normal-distribution system (oxide film) evaluated with the surface formula.

records.claim_ko: 사람 각질층에서 식 (18) 은 C_eff 1.66–1.86×10⁻² µF/cm², ε = 49 로 d_eff 2.3–2.6 µm 를 주었는데, 이는 알려진 10–40 µm 보다 훨씬 작다.
records.claim: For heat-separated human stratum corneum, Eq. (18) gave C_eff of 1.66–1.86×10^-2 µF/cm² and, with ε = 49, d_eff of 2.3–2.6 µm, far below the accepted 10–40 µm.
records.conditions: Normal distribution assumed; ε = 49 obtained from the Young-model comparison.

records.claim_ko: 피부에서는 식 (12) 가 식 (18) 보다 기대 두께에 가까운 값 (9.6·12·14 µm) 을 줬지만, R_e 는 피부의 유전 성질과 무관하므로 겉보기 일치일 뿐이라고 논문은 강조한다.
records.claim: For skin, Eq. (12) gave thicknesses (9.6, 12, 14 µm) closer to the expected value than Eq. (18) did, but the paper stresses that the agreement is only apparent, because R_e has no relation to the dielectric properties of skin.
records.conditions: Eq. (11) gave values close to Eq. (12) because R_f ≫ R_e. R_e itself is not printed.

records.claim_ko: 유전율이 균일하고 저항률이 ρ(x) = ρ0 e^(−x/λ) 로 감소하는 막 (Young 모델) 의 임피던스는 Z = −(λ/(jωεε0)) ln[(1 + jωεε0ρ0 e^(−δ/λ))/(1 + jωεε0ρ0)] 이다. 저주파에서 ρ0λ(1 − e^(−δ/λ)), 고주파에서 커패시턴스 εε0/δ 로 가며, 분산은 고주파에서만 생긴다.
records.claim: A film with uniform ε and resistivity decaying as ρ(x) = ρ0 e^(−x/λ) (the Young model) has Z = −(λ/(jωεε0)) ln[(1 + jωεε0ρ0 e^(−δ/λ))/(1 + jωεε0ρ0)]. Z tends to ρ0λ(1 − e^(−δ/λ)) at low frequency and to the capacitance εε0/δ at high frequency, and the dispersion appears only at high frequency.
records.math: Z = -(lambda/(j*omega*eps*eps0)) * ln[(1 + j*omega*eps*eps0*rho0*exp(-delta/lambda)) / (1 + j*omega*eps*eps0*rho0)] (Eq. 33); Z(omega->0) = lambda*rho0*(1 - exp(-delta/lambda)) (Eq. 34); Z(omega->inf) = -j*delta/(omega*eps*eps0) (Eq. 35)
records.conditions: Uniform dielectric constant; ρ0 is the maximum resistivity at x = 0 (oxide–electrolyte interface); λ = characteristic length; δ = thickness.

records.claim_ko: Young 임피던스를 CPE 로 읽기 위해 전해질 저항과 직렬인 R_f–CPE 병렬로 해석하고, ωεε0ρ0 = 1 이상의 각 주파수에서 Q·α 를 그래프로 구해 식 (18)·(25) 를 적용했다.
records.claim: To relate the Young impedance to CPE parameters, the paper analysed it as an R_f–CPE parallel combination in series with the electrolyte resistance, took Q and α graphically at each frequency above ωεε0ρ0 = 1, and applied Eqs. (18) and (25).
records.math: Z = R_e + R_f/(1 + (j*omega)^alpha*Q*R_f); C_eff = Q^(1/alpha) * R_f^((1-alpha)/alpha)
records.conditions: Normal (through-thickness) resistivity distribution.

records.claim_ko: Young 모델에서 식 (18)·(25) 의 d_eff 는 충분히 높은 주파수에서만 실제 두께 δ 와 같다. 유한한 측정 구간에서는 λ 와 δ 사이에 놓이며, δ/λ = 400 이면 ωεε0ρ0 = 10⁵ 에서도 δ 보다 두 자릿수 작다.
records.claim: In the Young model, d_eff from Eqs. (18) and (25) equals the true thickness δ only at high enough frequency. Over a finite band it lies between λ and δ: for δ/λ = 400 it is two orders of magnitude below δ even at ωεε0ρ0 = 10^5.

values.delta_over_lambda_400: d_eff two orders of magnitude below delta up to omega*eps*eps0*rho0 = 1e5
values.delta_over_lambda_5: d_eff approaches delta abruptly at omega*eps*eps0*rho0 = 1e2

records.conditions: Uniform ε, exponential resistivity, finite measurement band.

records.claim_ko: 막 안에서 국소 저항률이 크게 변하면 RC 주파수가 측정 구간보다 높은 부분은 순수 저항으로만 보여, 식 (18) 의 C_eff 가 가장 저항이 큰 부분만 보고 두께를 작게 낸다.
records.claim: When local resistivity varies strongly through a film, elements whose RC frequency lies above the measured range act as pure resistances, so C_eff from Eq. (18) sees only the most resistive part and under-predicts the thickness.
records.conditions: Normal distribution with strongly position-dependent resistivity (Fig. 11). The unseen capacitances may sit at the metal/film or the film/electrolyte interface.

records.claim_ko: C_eff 계산에 잘못된 유효 저항을 쓰면 전해질·전하전달·막 저항이 서로 크게 다를 수 있어 거시적인 오차가 난다.
records.claim: Using an incorrect effective resistance in the C_eff calculation can cause macroscopic errors, because electrolyte, charge-transfer and film resistances can differ greatly.
records.conditions: Any of Eqs. (11), (12) or (18) used with a resistance that does not match the distribution type.

records.claim_ko: Brug 식은 표면 분포에만, Hsu–Mansfeld 식은 두께 방향(normal) 분포에만 맞다.
records.claim: The Brug relations are appropriate only for a surface distribution of time constants, and the Hsu–Mansfeld relation only for a normal distribution.
records.conditions: The paper's main conclusion.

records.claim_ko: 공식은 계에 대한 독립적인 지식으로 골라야 한다. 국소 임피던스는 표면/두께 방향 불균일을, 분광법은 두께 방향으로 성질이 변하는 막의 존재를 보여 줄 수 있다.
records.claim: The choice of formula should rest on independent knowledge of the system: local impedance can reveal surface or normal inhomogeneity, and spectroscopic methods can reveal films whose properties vary normal to the surface.
records.conditions: Apart from the frequency-window argument in HIRSCHORN2010.nb-geometric-dispersion-outside-window, the paper offers no test that uses the global spectrum alone.
